次日，追梦早早的睡醒，随着养父养母一起来到1级县城，养父养母开始摆摊，追梦与他们分开，来到一间书店。
起源大陆货币单位分别是文、贯、银、金，兑换比例是1000文等于一贯，10贯等于一两白银，10两白银等于一两黄金。
而一文钱可以买一个肉包子，是那种个头大，里面肉比较多的肉包子。
一文钱还可以在路摊上买一碗面吃。
一摞新纸要一贯钱，一贯钱的一字虽然字小，但并不代表少，换做文钱，就是1000文钱，普通人在一级县城干活，省吃俭用的需要一年才能攒够。
书店老板开口就是一贯钱，追梦嫌贵是正常的。
闻声，追梦看去，眼前确实是旧纸，而且是别人使用过，上面写有字，放了很久的纸。
“老板，这纸你确定是用来卖的？”
老板看了一下追梦，又问道:“小伙子，你是头一次买纸吧！
是给你家主子买的吧？不知是用来做什么用的？”
追梦不高兴的说道，心里骂道:“真是狗眼看人低。”
接着追梦说道:“怎么的，这还有什么说法？”
书店老板一脸尴尬，接着指着那一摞旧纸说道:“小伙子，别看这纸旧，而且是别人用过的，很多刚刚学练字的人，都是买这个来练习的。
如果你是用来练字，我推荐你用这个纸，这个纸便宜，100文一摞，非常实惠。”
那我如果是用来画图，我该买哪种纸？”
追梦问道，心里又骂道:“瞧不起我，还想让我买一堆垃圾回去，真是黑心。”
“画图用纸有桑麻纸，麻布纹纸，桑皮纸，楮皮纸，小伙子你要那种。”
老板见追梦确实要买纸，也开始耐心的介绍道。

“桑麻纸纸质较好，表面平滑，有一定韧性，很适合画图。”
听到追梦要卖桑麻纸，书店老板立马像变了个人，非常客气的说道。
追梦一阵无语，心里骂道:“他妈的，一两白银，你当我是大款啊。
老子要那么多纸做什么，老子只打算买一两张纸画图的。”
嘴上也客气道:“一两白银没问题，不过我要先买一两张画图，试试质量，好的话我就买一摞。”
书店老板双眼转个不停，好像在思索追梦说话的真假。
书店老板还没见过这样卖纸的人，别人买纸都是一摞一摞的买，一次只买一两张纸的还是头一次，一时犯难，不知如何开价。
见书店老板半晌没回答，追梦催促道。
书店老板回道，接着算道:“一摞一两白银，共100张纸，一两白银等于10贯钱，又等于文，文除以100等于100文，二张纸共200文。”
追梦没有想到，自己只是买两张纸，用来画一些酿酒的工具的这么烦恼。
追梦买到纸后，自然就准备回家画图。

> Chapter 9 Brewing 2 (Page 1)
The next day, Zhui Meng woke up early and followed his adoptive father and mother to the first-level county town. The adoptive father and mother started setting up a stall. Zhui Meng separated from them and came to a bookstore.
The currency units of the mainland of origin are Wen, Guan, Silver, and Gold. The exchange ratio is 1,000 Wen equals one tael, 10 Guan equals one tael of silver, and 10 taels of silver equals one tael of gold.
And one penny can buy a meat bun, which is a big meat bun with a lot of meat inside.
You can buy a bowl of noodles at a street stall for just one penny.
A stack of new paper costs a penny. Although the word "qian" is small, it does not mean that it is less. In exchange for money, it is 1,000 penny. For ordinary people working in a first-level county town, it will take a year to save enough for those who live frugally.
The bookstore owner always talks about money, and it is normal for chasing dreams to be too expensive.
Hearing the sound, Zhui Meng looked around and saw that the paper in front of him was indeed old paper, and it was paper that had been used by others, had words written on it, and had been there for a long time.
"Boss, are you sure this paper is for sale?"
The boss looked at Chai Meng and asked again: "Young man, is this your first time buying paper?"
Did you buy it for your master? I wonder what it is used for? "
Zhui Meng said unhappily, cursing in his heart: "You are really looking down on others."
Then Zhui Meng said: "What, what else can I say?"
The bookstore owner looked embarrassed, then pointed to the pile of old paper and said: "Young man, this paper is old, and it has been used by others. Many people who have just learned calligraphy bought this to practice.
If you are using it to practice calligraphy, I recommend you to use this paper. This paper is cheap, 100 yuan per stack, very affordable. "
So if I am using it for drawing, what kind of paper should I buy? "
Zhui Meng asked, cursing in his heart: "You look down on me and want me to buy a bunch of rubbish back. It's really evil. "
"The paper used for drawing includes mulberry paper, linen paper, mulberry paper, and mulberry paper. Which one do you want, young man? "
Seeing that Chai Meng really wanted to buy paper, the boss began to introduce it patiently.
“Sangma paper has good quality, smooth surface, and a certain degree of toughness, making it very suitable for drawing. "
When I heard that Zhui Meng wanted to sell mulberry paper, the bookstore owner immediately changed his mind and said very politely.
Zhui Meng was speechless for a while, cursing in his mind: "Damn, one tael of silver, you think I'm a rich man.
What do I need so much paper for? I only plan to buy one or two pieces of paper for drawing pictures. "
He also said politely: "One tael of silver is fine, but I want to buy one or two paintings first to test the quality. If they are good, I will buy a bunch. "
The bookstore owner's eyes kept moving, as if he was pondering whether Zhui Meng's words were true or false.
The bookstore owner has never seen anyone selling paper like this. Others buy paper in piles. This is the first time he only buys one or two pieces of paper at a time. He is in trouble and doesn't know how to set a price.
Seeing that the bookstore owner didn't answer for a long time, Zhui Meng urged.
The bookstore owner replied, and then calculated: "A stack of one tael of silver, a total of 100 pieces of paper. One tael of silver is equal to 10 guan of money, which is also equal to Wen. Wen divided by 100 equals 100 Wen. Two pieces of paper total 200 Wen." "
Zhui Meng never imagined that he would be so troubled by just buying two pieces of paper to draw some wine-making tools.
After Chai Meng bought the paper, he was naturally ready to go home and draw pictures.
